paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on BioGPT.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of several models across a range of co-occurrence numbers. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 55, with tick marks at intervals of 5. A blue solid line, labeled “FT,” begins at approximately 35% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increases to approximately 46% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A purple solid line, labeled “Base,” starts around 30% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rises to approximately 42% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A red dashed line, labeled “IKE,” begins at roughly 33% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increases to approximately 41% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A cyan dashed line, labeled “MEMIT,” begins at approximately 36% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and grows to approximately 45% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A green solid line, labeled “ROME,” commences at around 44% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increases to a value of approximately 53% at a co-occurrence number of 1000.
